summary.lv: Spinwise (iGaming platforma) meklē vadošo izstrādātāju, kurš atbildēs par Core Web Vitals uzlabošanu, SSR/ISR optimizāciju, Redux un WebSocket veiktspēju, kā arī mentorēs komandu.
summary.en: Spinwise (iGaming platform) seeks a Lead Developer to own performance across their high-traffic Next.js/React/TypeScript platform, optimizing Core Web Vitals, SSR/ISR rendering, Redux and WebSocket performance while mentoring the team.
